decisions.reason: The candle arch is close to the core offer and featured on the home page, so it costs little to keep on the market while its seasonal demand becomes clearer.
The one-tier pyramid fits the established assortment and production skills, so keeping the option open is cheap and its prospects are still being tested.
This flagship music box line is distant from the core but gives the firm a strategic growth option, and one season reveals too little to justify abandoning it.

The motif platform is a low-visibility accessory tied to the music box option, so it is kept for now because dropping it early would weaken the flagship line, though it is a likely early cut if results disappoint.
The Christmas platform complements the music box system at low incremental cost, so it stays while the value of the platform line is still uncertain.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core competencies and was shown on the home page, offering steady tourist and gift appeal at minimal holding cost.
